verdict.rationale: Community evidence repeatedly refers to GlitchTip as an open-source/F/OSS Sentry alternative that can be self-hosted, implying source availability, but the evidence pack never cites a specific license (e.g., AGPL) or a link to the source repository itself. Missing for 10: explicit license statement, direct link/citation to the public source code repo, first-party confirmation of open licensing.
